breakdown.description: The listed weight fractions sum to 110%, but the Fox equation requires blend fractions that sum to 100%.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses wA = 0.65 and wB = 0.35, which sum to 1.00 (100%), matching the ground truth. The original error of 65% + 45% = 110% was fixed by changing the weight fraction of polymer B from 0.45 to 0.35.
